cast_tensor_type: recursively convert PyTorch tensors in nested inputs from one dtype or device to another
use_AvoidCUDAOOM_decorator: use the AvoidCUDAOOM singleton as a decorator to auto-retry a function on CUDA OOM with FP16 fallback
create_AvoidOOM_instance: create an AvoidOOM instance with custom to_cpu and test flags for tailored OOM retry behavior
retry_if_cuda_oom: wrap a stateless function with retry_if_cuda_oom to automatically fall back to FP16 or CPU on OOM
ignore_torch_cuda_oom_context: use the _ignore_torch_cuda_oom context manager to silently swallow CUDA out of memory exceptions
